categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Yanghe Distillery Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the production and sales of liquor, focusing on baijiu (Chinese liquor) with key brands including Yanghe, Shuijiu, and Shuang Gou. The company also operates in pre-packaged food wholesale and retail, grain procurement, and e-commerce platform construction. Its product portfolio includes mid-to-high-end and ordinary baijiu, as well as wine products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs solid-state fermentation technology for baijiu production, emphasizing a unique 'mianrou' (soft and mellow) flavor style. It has developed proprietary fermentation processes and microbial ecology research to enhance product quality. The production process includes raw material crushing, fermentation, distillation, grading, storage, blending, and packaging, supported by advanced quality control and digital platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yanghe serves a broad customer base across China, including distributors, retailers, and end consumers, with a focus on both offline wholesale and online direct sales channels. The company targets mid-to-high-end consumers seeking premium baijiu and also serves ordinary baijiu markets. Key markets include Jiangsu province and other regions across China, with expanding presence in hotel and group purchase channels.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with significant sales and production facilities in Jiangsu province, including Suqian city. It also has subsidiaries and operations in other provinces and international presence through subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Chile, and other locations. The company’s distribution network covers nationwide, with a focus on Jiangsu and surrounding markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yanghe operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the baijiu supply chain, focusing on production, blending, packaging, and distribution. It procures raw materials such as grains and packaging materials from upstream suppliers but controls the core production and brand marketing processes. The company also manages logistics and sales channels directly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus includes enhancing product quality through innovation in fermentation technology and microbial ecology, developing the 'mianrou' flavor system, and digital transformation of marketing and operations. R&D priorities include ecological and microbial studies of the Suqian baijiu production area, optimization of fermentation parameters, and development of new production techniques to support premium product lines. It also emphasizes sustainable development and ESG integration.
categories.revenue_model: Yanghe generates revenue primarily through the sale of baijiu and related alcoholic beverages, both via wholesale distribution and online direct sales. Revenue streams include product sales across different price segments, with additional income from pre-packaged food sales and investment income. The company follows a cash-before-delivery sales policy and recognizes revenue upon transfer of control to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yanghe is one of the leading large-scale baijiu producers in China, holding a strong market position with well-known brands and multiple national trademarks. It competes with other top-tier Chinese liquor companies, benefiting from its dual brand strategy (Yanghe and Shuang Gou) and recognized heritage. The company ranks third in brand value among Chinese baijiu brands and fifth globally in liquor brand value.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Yanghe reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 28.88 billion, a 12.83% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 6.67 billion, down 33.37%. The company has total assets of RMB 67.35 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 51.59 billion. Despite recent revenue and profit declines due to market competition, the company maintains a strong financial scale and continues strategic investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yanghe emphasizes its unique 'mianrou' soft and mellow baijiu flavor profile, supported by proprietary fermentation technology and ecological advantages of its production region. The company leverages its dual brand strategy with heritage brands and premium product lines to meet diverse consumer preferences. Its strong brand equity, quality assurance, and extensive marketing network differentiate it in a competitive market, focusing on consumer-centric innovation and sustainable growth.
